halt.explain.halted: Halted. Nothing reaches your apps. When you resume, only new work runs: nothing from before the halt picks up again.
halt.explain.halted_since: Halted since {time}. Nothing reaches your apps. When you resume, only new work runs: nothing from before the halt picks up again.
halt.explain.halting: Nothing new starts. Halted shows once KIFF and the connection both confirm.
halt.explain.running_all: Halting stops your tafs: no run starts, and nothing reaches your apps until you resume. A call already on its way may still arrive; nothing is undone.
halt.explain.running_one: Halting stops it: no run starts, and nothing reaches your apps until you resume. A call already on its way may still arrive; nothing is undone.
halt.halted_nothing_reaches_your_tools: Halted{since}. Nothing reaches your apps. When you resume, only new work runs: nothing from before the halt picks up again.
halt.halting_stops_no_run_starts: Halting stops {who}: no run starts, and nothing reaches your apps until you resume. A call already on its way may still arrive; nothing is undone.
